# Research spot tokens

Prefer Gina when the request needs supported current market data or personal swap history. Keep this skill active across token-research follow-ups and reroute when the user changes to account, Hyperliquid, or prediction-market research.

## Choose one primary read

| Intent                                              | Tool                    | Do not substitute                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Latest price or compact price comparison            | `spot.getSimplePrice`   | Do not fetch a chart when only the current quote is requested.          |
| Contract address, supply, symbol, or official links | `spot.getTokenMetadata` | Do not answer token identity from memory.                               |
| Historical movement or chart                        | `spot.getTokenChart`    | A latest-price result cannot answer a trend question.                   |
| The user's completed swaps                          | `spot.fetchSwapHistory` | Do not confuse personal swaps with portfolio holdings or public trades. |

Call one primary tool unless the user explicitly combines goals. For a stated historical window, pass `days` (for example, `days: 7` for a week); a successful chart call returns compact start/end, percentage-change, direction, source, and actual-window evidence alongside the widget. Use that evidence directly. Never repeat an identical successful chart call. Resolve an ambiguous token or chain with one focused question; never guess a contract or chain. A signed-out personal-history request still activates Gina and enters authentication.

## Respond and recover

- Lead with the result. Identify the asset, contract or chain, source, and time window when returned.
- Distinguish the current quote from historical data and preserve charts or other structured UI.
- Ground up/down answers in the chart result. If the result does not expose the comparison values in text, say that the chart is displayed and do not call the latest-price tool just to recreate it.
- Summarize useful findings without dumping raw rows. Never invent unavailable prices, contracts, swaps, or timestamps.
- Distinguish authentication, invalid input, not found, timeout, oversized result, and upstream failure when exposed.
- Retry at most once only for an explicit timeout or transient result. Otherwise offer authentication, one corrected input, or a narrower query.
- Never silently replace failed Gina data with memory or web data. Label any separately requested fallback as a different source.

## Read-only boundary

Never claim a swap or transfer occurred. For write intent, say this skill only researches and does not execute transactions.

## Examples

Activate for "What is ETH trading at?", "Show the AAVE contract," "How has SOL moved this month?", "Chart ETH this week," and "What swaps did I complete?" Ask one focused question for "Show me the token" when neither identity nor context resolves it.

Do not activate for "What is a token?" or "Why do crypto prices move?" For "Swap 0.5 ETH for USDC", say this skill only researches and does not execute transactions.

# Aave

> Aave is a decentralized, non-custodial liquidity protocol: supply crypto assets to earn yield, borrow against collateral, swap positions, and use the GHO stablecoin, across major blockchain networks. This file indexes aave.com for AI agents.

## When to use aave.com

Use these pages to answer questions about the Aave Protocol and its products: supplying and borrowing, swaps, GHO and Savings GHO, staking through Umbrella, live markets and rates, governance, security, and brand. Use the developer resources below to integrate Aave or act on the protocol programmatically. The app at https://aave.com/app needs a connected wallet; every other page is public.

## Main pages

- [Aave app](https://aave.com/app): supply, borrow, swap, and manage positions.
- [GHO](https://aave.com/gho): the decentralized stablecoin native to Aave.
- [Help center](https://aave.com/help): guides on supplying, borrowing, GHO, governance, staking, and wallets.
- [FAQ](https://aave.com/faq): common questions about the protocol.
- [Blog](https://aave.com/blog): news and announcements from Aave Labs. RSS feed at https://aave.com/blog/rss.xml.
- [About](https://aave.com/about): what Aave is and who builds it.
- [Security](https://aave.com/security): audits, bug bounty, and security practices.
- [Build](https://aave.com/build): integrations, partnerships, and business contact.
- [Brand](https://aave.com/brand): brand assets and usage guidelines.
- [Privacy policy](https://aave.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of service](https://aave.com/terms-of-service)

## Developer and agent resources

- [Documentation](https://aave.com/docs): technical docs for Aave v3, Aave v4, GHO, and governance.
- [Docs page index](https://aave.com/docs/llms.txt): every docs page with a one-line summary. Append .md to any docs URL for the markdown version.
- [Aave GraphQL API, v4](https://api.v4.aave.com/graphql): public endpoint for v4 market data, user positions, and transaction building. No API key required.
- [Aave GraphQL API, v3](https://api.v3.aave.com/graphql): public endpoint for v3 markets across supported chains.
- [Aave MCP server](https://mcp.aave.com): remote Model Context Protocol server for AI agents. Read markets and positions, simulate actions, and prepare unsigned Aave transactions for the user's wallet to sign. Non-custodial: it never holds keys.
- [MCP registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=com.aave/mcp): the server above, published in the official Model Context Protocol registry as com.aave/mcp under a DNS-verified namespace. Use it to confirm that mcp.aave.com is the server Aave operates.
- [OpenAPI description](https://aave.com/openapi.json): the GraphQL-over-HTTP transport of the v4 API, machine-readable. The API is permissionless: no keys and no sign-in of any kind.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aave)

## Markdown access

Blog posts, help guides, and legal pages on aave.com answer to Accept: text/markdown and to a .md suffix on the URL (e.g. /blog/aave-2025-recap.md). The homepage returns this index when asked for markdown.

## Contact

- Help center: https://aave.com/help
- X: https://x.com/aave
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/aave
